Class GroundTruthAuditGenerator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.GroundTruthAuditGenerator
public class GroundTruthAuditGenerator extends Object
Cliodynamic Ground Truth Audit and Parameter Drift Analysis Generator.

Benchmarking and epistemic validation harness evaluating simulated societal trajectories against empirical historical reality (Seshat Global History Databank, HYDE 3.4, Maddison Project, and EPICA ice core reconstructions).

Computes Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Cohen's \(d\) effect size, 95% confidence intervals, and statistical bifurcation onsets.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
